text:
elaine (partnerships): Heads-up: we need to finalize the partner-facing comms & helpline plan for the SDK sunset window next month. Who can own the announcement cadence + staging channel?

sarah (eng): I can own the staging channel ops. will need a canary window for marketplace adapters though (2 days) and a rollback play.

mike (platform): +1 for canary. also need a compatibility matrix export from eng — current plan supports v2, v3, and shim v4. can we produce a CSV for partners?

elaine (partnerships): @sarah thanks. @mike yes CSV needed. also want a short partner FAQ and a hotline rota during the first 72 hrs after public notice.

jordan (product): I can draft the FAQ and the announcement copy. propose timeline: internal FYI on Tue, partner embargo Wed AM, public Thu. ok?

ron (eng-infra): For the hotline, ops can stand a pager but we need clear handoff. suggest creating a dedicated Slack channel #partnerships-sunset-hotline and add oncall rotations. also: tag releases as `compat/sunset-2026-05`

sarah (eng): CSV request: i'll generate `partner_compat_171888.csv` with columns: partner, sdk_versions_supported, recommended_migration, broken_edges. will drop in the shared drive by EOD tomorrow.

elaine (partnerships): draft announcement (short):
```
Hi partners — on May 12 we'll begin deprecating SDK v2 endpoints in favor of v3. You'll have a 60-day grace period and automated compatibility shims for common patterns. See FAQ + migration guide: https://redwood.co/partners/mig-guide
```

jordan (product): love it. for market-specific partners we should add region notes (APAC certs, EU privacy). i'll annotate the FAQ.

mike (platform): one technical ask: can we guarantee that shim responses include `x-rw-compat: v2-shim` header so partners can detect fallback? if yes, i'll add to docs.

ron (eng-infra): yes we can add header. will need a canary flag in runtime: `--enable-compat-shim`. we'll coordinate with sarah for rollout window.

partner-bot: partners list snapshot: [CloudMarket, HW-SI-Works, GlobalSI, EdgeRetail]. last contact: CloudMarket (alice@cloudmarket.com).

elaine (partnerships): action items recap: 1) sarah: compatibility CSV by EOD tomorrow. 2) jordan: FAQ + announcement copy by Tue morning. 3) ron: runtime flag + header implementation and rollout plan. 4) mike: add shim header specimen to docs. 5) i'll coordinate partner embargo emails and schedule the #partnerships-sunset-hotline channel.

mike (platform): small note — we should include a snippet partners can paste to test compatibility: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v3/compat-check?partner=CloudMarket
```

elaine (partnerships): perfect. i'll start drafting the partner embargo list now. thanks all :thumbsup:
